learningObjective.stringValue: Use evidence to explain indigenous arts, crafts, and technologies.

lessonRecap.stringValue: Makers use knowledge of materials and their properties. A material suitable for one task may not suit another. Weaving can make baskets, mats and textiles. Preparing materials and controlling the pattern require practice. Technology is not limited to electric devices. Pottery, carving and boatbuilding involve methods and tools. Designs can have meanings connected with community practices. Not every pattern has the same meaning or is free to copy. Craft knowledge can be passed through teaching, observation and practice. Makers may also adapt to new materials and needs.
